 State of Odisha & Anr. .... Opp.Parties

CORAM:
 JUSTICE SASHIKANTA MISHRA  ORDER 17.01.2024 Order No. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

02.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Pahal P.S. Case No. 244 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.1133 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C.(O),
Bhubaneswar for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/406/294/352/506 of IPC.
4. The petitioners are employees and Director of M/s. Greenbilt Castings Pvt. Ltd.
The principal accused in this case is Aditya Agarwal.
The I.O. has complied with the provision under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. in respect of the principal accused.
The allegations against the petitioners are that they had abused and threatened the informant.
5. Having regard to the nature of accusations and materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioners to surrender before the Court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
(Sashikanta Mishra) Judge A.K. Rana Designation: PERSONAL ASSISTANT
